name: samalone-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Stuart A. Malone

metadata.description: Personal Claude Plugin Marketplace for Stuart A. Malone

plugins.name: 1Password
plugins.description: Securely work with 1Password through the op CLI. Manage vaults, items, and secrets without exposing plaintext values to Claude.

plugins.name: personal-project
plugins.description: Workflow profile for single-maintainer personal projects: temporary branches instead of PRs, automatic code-review and simplification passes, and merge/cleanup conventions.

plugins.name: xcode-project
plugins.description: Workflow profile for Xcode projects: conventions for building, testing, and working with Xcode and Apple platform targets, plus automatic setup of the Xcode MCP server. Self-gating — emits nothing unless a .xcodeproj or .xcworkspace is found.

plugins.name: bd
plugins.description: Everything for beads (bd) projects that the public beads plugin does not provide: self-gating PR-workflow guidance injected at SessionStart, the /bd:plan bead-planning skill, the /bd:config-audit Dolt configuration audit, and the /bd:change-mode embedded/server switcher. Designed to sit on top of beads@beads-marketplace rather than replace it. The guidance emits nothing unless a .beads/ directory is found.
